forWhat: The first page you see. It lists the kinds of work waiting on you, in the order the week runs.
Each kind of work is one line with its count and the next thing to do. Open a line to see its rows. Each row has its own button.

layout.shows: The button [[Start with:]] takes you to the first job waiting. With nothing waiting it opens Assessments.
How many jobs wait on you, and how many will be ready later.
Subject, Class and What. They narrow the list below. The count line stays the same.
One folded line for each kind, such as [[Skills to approve]], [[Topics to mark as taught]], [[Answers to check]] and [[Parent reports to approve]]. Open one to see its rows.
A folded note of what the school's answers say this week.

jobs.title: Start your day
steps: Open What needs doing from the top bar.
Press [[Start with:]] to go to the first job, or open any line to see its rows.
Press the button on a row to do that one job. The line's count goes down as you work.

jobs.title: Say a topic was taught
steps: Open the line [[Topics to mark as taught]].
Press the row's button. If the topic is taught in more than one of your classes, choose the class first.
The topic is now taught for that class alone. Its skills can go on that class's papers.

buttons.label: Start with:
buttons.does: Opens the first job waiting on you.
buttons.doesNot: It does not do the job for you.

buttons.label: Next:
buttons.does: On each line, opens the next job of that kind.

buttons.label: Topics to mark as taught
buttons.does: A row's button records the topic as taught for that one class, in your name.
